commonSettings.label: Idle session timeout (seconds)
commonSettings.description: How long a chat session stays warm after its last request before it is closed. 0 keeps it until the agent stops.

commonSettings.label: Idle agent shutdown (minutes)
commonSettings.description: Stop the agent process after this many idle minutes. 0 never stops it. It starts again on the next request.

commonSettings.label: Dump requests (debug)
commonSettings.description: Write each request Copilot sends to a JSON file in the extension's storage folder. The files hold the whole prompt, so keep this off unless you are debugging.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the Claude agent uses when both an API key and a signed-in account (OAuth) are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved API key when there is one, otherwise the signed-in account.
Use the saved API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its signed-in account.
Always use the signed-in account and ignore the saved API key and the key environment variables.

settings.label: Tool search
settings.description: Whether Copilot's tools are loaded on demand. On: the model sees only tool names and fetches a tool's description when it needs it, which makes each request much smaller but can add a lookup step before a tool is first used (not supported by every model, Haiku included). Off: every tool's full description is sent with every request. Default: the agent decides. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Send every tool's description with every request.

settings.label: Show thinking text
settings.description: On: the chat shows a summary of Claude's reasoning in a collapsed Thinking block. Off: the chat shows no thinking text, as when Claude leaves it out of the stream. The model thinks and the tokens are billed the same either way. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Replace the Claude Code system prompt
settings.description: On: Claude's built-in Claude Code prompt is replaced by Copilot's guidance for the chat; only the agent's one-line identity stays. Off: Copilot's guidance is added to the end of the Claude Code prompt. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the Codex agent uses when both an OpenAI API key and a ChatGPT account are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved OpenAI API key when there is one, otherwise the ChatGPT account.
Use the saved OpenAI API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its ChatGPT account.
Always use the ChatGPT account: the saved API key is ignored and CODEX_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are withheld from the agent.

settings.label: Largest context window
settings.description: Ask Codex for the largest context window each model allows instead of its default. Models that cannot be raised keep their default. A larger window delays compaction, so long chats re-send more history on every turn and use up your plan limits faster. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Replace the Codex system prompt
settings.description: On: Codex's built-in instructions, bundled skills and environment notes are replaced by a one-line identity, and Copilot's guidance for the chat is added after it. Off: Copilot's guidance is added to Codex's own instructions. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Agent command
settings.description: Path of the Antigravity CLI (agy) to run. Leave empty to use the one the extension downloads. The same program also forks chats and reads the quota.

settings.label: Agent arguments
settings.description: Arguments for the program. Leave empty for the default (acp --app-data-dir=antigravity-copilot --process-per-session).

settings.label: Use the agent's built-in tools
settings.description: Let the Antigravity agent use its own file, shell and search tools. When off (default), the extension runs its own Antigravity agent with an empty tool allowlist, so Antigravity's built-in tools are gone and only the Copilot chat tools are available. The extension automatically approves agent permission requests; built-in tools do not use Copilot confirmations. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Replace the Antigravity system prompt
settings.description: On: the chat's agent takes Copilot's identity instead of Antigravity's persona, and Copilot's guidance for the chat follows. Off: it keeps a short Antigravity persona, with the same guidance after it. Antigravity's own generated prompt is replaced either way; its sections about skills, artifacts and messaging stay. This needs the extension's own agent, which has no Antigravity tools of its own. Changing it restarts the agent.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Which credentials the agent uses when both a Gemini API key and a signed-in account are available. Changing it restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Use the saved API key when there is one, otherwise the signed-in account.
Use the saved API key. Without one, the agent falls back to its signed-in account.
Always use the signed-in account and ignore the saved API key and the key environment variables.
